scope: world-aligned mesh sections, frustum visibility, retained GPU buffers and animation redraw signals
checks: negative world section alignment and cross-section neighbor culling
contiguous draw ranges bound actual float32 geometry including overhangs
clipping retains exposed model faces without modifying blocks
WebGPU zero-to-one near/far and side-plane visibility
opaque range draws and visible transparent face indices
projection-only blend subset refresh and unchanged-view sort reuse
buffer capacity reuse, atomic allocation failure, bounded growth, empty uploads and idempotent disposal
animation signals only changed referenced images
limits: Controlled Node worker/device/animation probes only; no native build, terrain generation, registry/state sweep, broad suite or GitHub workflow.
